truth_contract.real_cases: unknown: baseline positives are reference-relative evidence; misses are not negatives

sequence_contract.block_order: strictly increasing block_offset, visit_index, and source counter

stress_protocol.primary: process every visit causally without injected disruption

forced_state_drop.action: clear every cache in the block before processing this visit

processing_outage.action: mark visits unprocessed and forbid detector output or state update; resume at the next retained visit

wrong_cache.action: lookup only the remapped channel cache for the same receiver/edge/rate; the innovation gate must reject inconsistency and invoke blind fallback

short_age_stress.scope: independent sensitivity scenario, not the primary state policy
